answers.reason: Deans are faculty leaders and do not belong to the university leadership, so they do not automatically take part in the senate unless specified.
Budget planning rounds involve funding across the university plan, allowing higher-ranking groups to participate.
Appointments are part of the university-wide plan handled by groups of higher rank.
A dean leads a faculty and participates in the affairs of that faculty.
Examination matters are part of the university-wide plan managed at higher levels.
